Title: `scan-qr-code` refuses a missing or malformed token
Steps: 1. POST `scan-qr-code` with no Authorization header 2. repeat with `Bearer not-a-jwt`
Expected result: both refused (HTTP 401/403, or HTTP 200 with `status` 0) and no data returned

Title: `scan-qr-code` rejects a scan with no route_id (refused before any lookup) cleanly
Expected result: a handled refusal (HTTP 200 `status` 0, or 4xx) with no data; never HTTP 5xx or SQL text
